MARINE AND FISHERIES TECHNOLOGY — TERMLY EXAM #11
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: MARINE AND FISHERIES TECHNOLOGY
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Ice melting to water
   B. Iron rusting
   C. Paper burning to ash
   D. Milk souring

2. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Glucose and oxygen
   B. Only water vapour
   C. Only carbon dioxide
   D. Nitrogen gas only

3. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 0 °C
   B. 100 °C
   C. 50 °C
   D. 37 °C

4. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   B. Petrol fires have no fuel
   C. Water removes heat too quickly
   D. Water always increases oxygen

5. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Removing all vegetation
   B. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   C. Overgrazing continuously
   D. Burning crop residue every week

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fundamentals of Marine and freshwater fisheries Technology 1.2 Fish morphology a? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fundamentals of Marine and freshwater fisheries Technology 1.2 Fish morphology a.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fundamentals of Marine and freshwater fisheries Technology 1.2 Fish morphology a.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fundamentals of Marine and freshwater fisheries Technology 1.2 Fish morphology a.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Fundamentals of Marine and freshwater fisheries Technology 1.2 Fish morphology a.

7. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture of two liquids
   B. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   C. Any substance that conducts electricity
   D. Any white crystal used in cooking

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish Pond? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish Pond.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish Pond.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Fish Pond.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish Pond.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fundamentals of Aquaculture? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fundamentals of Aquaculture.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fundamentals of Aquaculture.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Fundamentals of Aquaculture.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fundamentals of Aquaculture.

10. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. joule (J)
   B. pascal (Pa)
   C. watt (W)
   D. newton (N)

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Production Systems? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Production Systems.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Production Systems.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Production Systems.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Production Systems.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fundamentals of Capture Fisheries? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fundamentals of Capture Fisheries.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fundamentals of Capture Fisheries.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Fundamentals of Capture Fisheries.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fundamentals of Capture Fisheries.

13. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Decomposers only
   B. Tertiary consumers
   C. Producers
   D. Primary consumers only

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish morphology and anatomy 2.0 Aquaculture 2.1 Fundamentals of Aquaculture 2.2 ? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish morphology and anatomy 2.0 Aquaculture 2.1 Fundamentals of Aquaculture 2.2 .
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Fish morphology and anatomy 2.0 Aquaculture 2.1 Fundamentals of Aquaculture 2.2 .
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish morphology and anatomy 2.0 Aquaculture 2.1 Fundamentals of Aquaculture 2.2 .
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish morphology and anatomy 2.0 Aquaculture 2.1 Fundamentals of Aquaculture 2.2 .

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Safety and Survival Techniques Page 15 of 34 1 STRAND 1.0: FISH BIOLOGY AND ECOL? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Safety and Survival Techniques Page 15 of 34 1 STRAND 1.0: FISH BIOLOGY AND ECOL.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Safety and Survival Techniques Page 15 of 34 1 STRAND 1.0: FISH BIOLOGY AND ECOL.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Safety and Survival Techniques Page 15 of 34 1 STRAND 1.0: FISH BIOLOGY AND ECOL.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Safety and Survival Techniques Page 15 of 34 1 STRAND 1.0: FISH BIOLOGY AND ECOL.

16. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Production Systems 2.3 Fish pond 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1. Fundamentals of capt? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Production Systems 2.3 Fish pond 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1. Fundamentals of capt.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Production Systems 2.3 Fish pond 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1. Fundamentals of capt.
